reviewSamples.author: Photo of Iris Rose Feraldi
reviewSamples.text:
I can't recommend Groomingdale Pet Salon enough! My dog, Marshmallow, is extremely difficult when it comes to having his nails trimmed. We've been to other groomers where they weren't able to finish the job, and at our last visit elsewhere, he was left with only half of his nails trimmed because he was so stressed.

The team at Groomingdale Pet Salon was completely different. They were incredibly patient, gentle, and nurturing, taking the time to help Marshmallow feel safe and comfortable. To my surprise and relief, they were able to trim all of his nails without any problems.

Their kindness, skill, and calm approach made all the difference. If you have a nervous or challenging dog, I highly recommend Groomingdale Pet Salon. They truly went above and beyond, and I'm so grateful for the wonderful care they gave Marshmallow!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Valorie Wilson
reviewSamples.text: Groomingdales was great!  They did a terrific job grooming my dog who can be challenging at times with new people and other dogs.  Will definitely be a repeat customer!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of w b
reviewSamples.text: I've taken my 3yo Golden Retreiver to Groomingdales twice now.  Both times could not have gone better.  Like all(hopefully)dog owners, I get very nervous leaving my dog with anyone I don't really know.  The people at this grooming salon are really, really awesome.  The first time I had major separation anxiety.  When I picked up my Golden, he was calm and did not appear scared or nervous at all.  I could tell this was NOT a traumatic experience for him.   The second time, same thing.  Both when I dropped him off and picked him up, he was not scared or nervous at all.  That is a clear sign that these people really care about the animals they groom.  Now I must mention what an awesome job they did with the grooming Both times.  They did an absolutely wonderful job!  I get so many compliments when I take him out in public.  I was referred to Groomingdales by another Golden owner who uses them.  I will always recommend Groomingdales.  Thank you Groomingdales staff for taking such GREAT care of my dog, and making him look so handsome!  Highly recommend this wonderful grooming salon!!

reviewSamples.text: 15 years and Lilly still loves this place.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Kimberly Croddy
reviewSamples.text: I love them so much. They take your dog in, do the grooming and you can pick your dog up without having to leave your dog for more than a few hours which is super wonderful. And my Shifu always looks perfect.  I am very happy with them and so is my pup.  Trisha a great and a very nice person.
